capabilities.description: A controlled register of all project documents (contract, BOQ, drawings, ITPs, certificates) with revision control, provenance, and the ability to trace every downstream record back to the source document it cites.

Compile and certify progress claims item by item against the BOQ, applying the contract's retention (Clause 14.3, 5% per interim payment certificate with 50% release at Taking-Over and 50% at end of the Defects Notification Period) and carrying forward certified quantities.

Track elapsed time against the contractual time for completion (Clause 8.2, 730 days from Commencement Date), compute delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day capped at 10% (Clause 8.7), and flag exposure with supporting evidence for any extension-of-time position.

Create, hold and close out inspection and test plan (ITP) records: inspection points, hold/witness status, sign-offs, defects raised and defect close-out through the Defects Notification Period (Clause 11.1, 365 days from Taking-Over).

Track the contractual securities and releases — performance security at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount (Clause 4.2) and retention deductions and releases (Clause 14.3) — against their milestone trigger dates.

Ingest, index and parse the uploaded contract and BOQ as the authoritative source of record, resolving every claim, delay calculation and inspection record to the clause or BOQ item it depends on, and refusing to proceed when a governing term cannot be found.

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that treats the uploaded contract and bill of quantities as the single source of record. It serves the project's contract administration and delivery team by managing progress claims against the BOQ, tracking delay damages against the contractual time for completion, recording QA/ITP inspection and test records, and maintaining a controlled document register — each tied back to the governing clause or BOQ item it derives
